dedupe_keys.name: california licensed and certified healthcare facility listing and bed types and counts

description: These two linked data sets list every operational healthcare facility licensed by the California Department of Public Health or certified by Medicare and Medicaid, and the beds each one holds. The facility listing gives the facility identifier, name, licence type (more than 30 types, from general acute care hospitals and skilled nursing facilities to clinics and home health agencies), status, address, county and coordinates; the bed file gives each facility's bed types and capacities, with a county summary for general acute care hospitals. The producer is the Licensing and Certification Program of the California Department of Public Health, extracting from its Electronic Licensing Management System, published on the California Health and Human Services Open Data Portal. Coverage is the State of California at facility level, refreshed monthly. Files are CSV with data dictionaries, free without registration, under the portal's terms of use; no licence is named. Caveats: coordinates can be missing until the next monthly refresh, facility identifiers differ from those of the Department of Health Care Access and Information and need the published crosswalk, and licensed beds are not staffed or available beds. Simulation uses: a facility-level inventory of inpatient and long-term care capacity for earthquake, wildfire and flood exposure analysis, evacuation and surge planning. Related records: HCAI hospital utilisation and financial data (data-hcai-hospital-utilization-and-financial) adds occupancy and services.
